name: Deathbringer Stance: target-health magic strike
targetName: one Deathbringer Stance bonus magic packet
objective: Investigate high one Deathbringer Stance bonus magic packet output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
mechanic: The passive helper scales from 4% to 10% of enemy maximum HP with champion level, with no direct AD or AP coefficient. Penetration and eligible amplification are the experiment; item AP alone does not increase the core percentage. The normal attack delivering the passive and its healing are separate outputs.
finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. No free permanent stacks. Record actual AD/AP and resists. Loaded owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 3s. Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. Stop observed scoring on death and report raw overkill separately. Passive ready for one champion attack. Riftmaker legally pre-ramped in separate combat; record actual Shojin stacks reached through qualifying abilities, do not assume four from elapsed time. Abyssal victim inside its actual aura range. No allied MR debuffs.
test: Compare the isolated passive magic packet with and without each amplifier, at 1500 and 6000 target maximum HP. Test a raw-AP slot as a negative scaling control. Measure the delivering physical attack and healing separately.
limits: Ability-damage eligibility for passive amplification must be checked in game. No AP ratio, critical multiplier on the magic packet, or attack-plus-heal sum presented as passive damage. The item set intentionally tests eligibility and is not a proven efficient build.
tradeoff: Six slots spend heavily on penetration and disputed passive amplification while sacrificing ordinary AD damage and defense.

name: Heroic Swing: counted-shot AD and attack-speed test
targetName: Heroic Swing shots in one three-second observation
objective: Investigate high Heroic Swing shots in one three-second observation output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
mechanic: The per-shot helper is (8/16/24/32/40 + 0.25 total AD) times (1 + 0.3 times the bonus-attack-speed stat term). Bonus attack speed therefore has potential beyond ordinary attack frequency, but its stat normalization and the number of legal shots must be observed. Collision and release can end the swing. A separate critical helper scales the core by 1 + 0.5 times (critical-damage stat minus 1); this is a special critical rule, not automatic ordinary-attack crit inheritance.
finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. No free permanent stacks. Exactly 10 earned Hubris kills with its temporary AD buff active. One uninterrupted legal swing, no takedown refresh; count actual shots and final disengage shot that occur within three seconds. Isolate one champion from other selectable enemies. Owner begins at full health.
test: Swap Phantom Dancer for a flat-AD slot, recording actual AD, bonus AS, per-shot core physical damage and shot timestamps. Repeat a swing interrupted by collision. Report Blade/Wits End and rune proc packets separately from E core damage. Test critical and noncritical shots separately against the special source helper, including a controlled Infinity Edge swap if testing critical damage.
limits: No assumed full on-hit effectiveness, ordinary-attack critical multiplier, fractional shot count or endless takedown loop. Source AS stat units require client confirmation; three seconds is a finite observation, not a guaranteed full-duration swing.
tradeoff: High theoretical scaling loses value when terrain, enemy position or collision shortens the actual swing.
